tn_woodcock_cove.name: Woodcock Cove
tn_woodcock_cove.note: No source found naming months for this crag; only a generic 'year-round in Tennessee'.

bc_aberdeen_columns.name: Aberdeen Columns
bc_aberdeen_columns.note: HELD by reviewer: window is a hiking snow-free approach, not a climbing season. Hiking guide names May-Oct (snow-free approach); Tourism Vernon says spring through fall. Not climbing-specific; approach-driven window.

bc_north_wall_boulders.name: North Wall Boulders
bc_north_wall_boulders.note: KAYA: prime Squamish bouldering early April to October (October best for hard sends); MadBoulder: late spring through early fall. System-wide; North Wall has rockfall closures, check access.

co_telluride_norwood_area.name: Telluride/Norwood area
co_telluride_norwood_area.note: Fowler/Johnston guidebook: summer best, high-country rock mid-Jun to mid-Sep; travel guide names May-Sep. Winter is ice only.

md_great_falls_maryland_side.name: Great Falls - Maryland Side
md_great_falls_maryland_side.note: No source names months; only that it is climbable year-round and west-facing cliffs suit winter afternoons.

az_waterfall_the_2.name: Waterfall, The
az_waterfall_the_2.note: Guide names spring Mar-May and fall Sep-Nov; Mountain Project warns creek crossing can be impassable in high water in early spring. Season taken from Sedona/Oak Creek sources.

co_mecca_area.name: Mecca Area
co_mecca_area.note: Only season words for Unaweep Canyon (spring and fall best, shade in summer, winter friction); no months named.

co_eldorado_mountain.name: Eldorado Mountain
co_eldorado_mountain.note: Reviewer: Eldorado Canyon window as on Redgarden Wall (round 2). Fox in the Forest: April-October; Mountain Guides: March-November, Sep-Oct best; thetopo: spring and autumn best. Sources speak for Eldorado Canyon generally; Eldorado Mountain is the same crag system.

ky_cathedral_domain_climbing_area_cdca.name: Cathedral Domain Climbing Area (CDCA)
ky_cathedral_domain_climbing_area_cdca.note: Reviewer: Red River Gorge system window (round 1, high). Climb-Europe names Oct-Nov best, spring good but wetter, summer hot; MojoGear: spring and fall. Season is for the whole Red River Gorge system; spring months mapped from season word.

ut_new_joe_s.name: New Joe's
ut_new_joe_s.note: KAYA: fall Sep-Nov best, spring Mar-May also excellent, summer off. Valley-wide; New Joe's boulders are warmest/driest in winter so winter can also work.

or_rocky_butte.name: Rocky Butte
or_rocky_butte.note: Only rainy-season warnings (starts Sep/mid-Oct) and anecdotal 'summer most dependable'; no month-naming source.

wv_upper_meadow.name: Upper Meadow
wv_upper_meadow.note: No Meadow River-specific source; NPS for the New River Gorge region names late Apr-mid Jun and mid Sep-late Oct, KAYA names Oct-Nov and Mar-May. Shared window taken; applied to Meadow River as part of the New River Gorge system.

al_moss_rock_preserve.name: Moss Rock Preserve
al_moss_rock_preserve.note: One source only: 'fall and winter' (season words, no months, no second source).

ca_14_whitney_surrounding_peaks.name: Whitney & Surrounding Peaks
ca_14_whitney_surrounding_peaks.note: Guide services run Whitney/High Sierra climbs late May-Oct; USFS trail snow-free July-late Sept. Window is June-October (snow and ice early in the season).

co_10_mile_canyon.name: 10 Mile Canyon
co_10_mile_canyon.note: Frisco guide names May-Oct for rock (winter is ice/mixed); crag pages say late spring through early fall. Sources are marketing-grade; moderate confidence.

ut_gate_buttress.name: Gate Buttress
ut_gate_buttress.note: KAYA: fall and spring peak, Oct/Nov sweet spot; Salt Lake guide lists Apr, May, Jun, Sep, Oct. Canyon-wide; summer viable on shade only.

va_buttermilks_the.name: Buttermilks, The
va_buttermilks_the.note: No Richmond-specific season source found (results were for the California Buttermilks).

az_main_boulders.name: Main Boulders
az_main_boulders.note: Prescott sources give only 'spring and fall' words, no months, for Groom Creek.

az_east_stronghold.name: East Stronghold
az_east_stronghold.note: Bouldering guide names October-April; Mountain Project says spring and fall best, winter good on sun; tour operator fall through spring. Raptor closures Feb 15-Jun 30 on some domes (mostly West Stronghold).

ca_foreplay_bouldering.name: Foreplay Bouldering
ca_foreplay_bouldering.note: Only season words for the Apple Valley/Fairview high desert (late fall through early spring, or spring/fall); no months named.
